rawRecord.EXPERIMENTAL_ai_generated_description: Universal Crypto provides a comprehensive toolkit for interacting with EVM-compatible blockchain networks through natural language interfaces. It offers modular functionality across specialized domains including DeFi operations (swaps, lending, staking), security analysis (rug pull detection, honeypot checking), cross-chain bridging, NFT management, and portfolio tracking. The server enables complex blockchain operations like analyzing transactions, checking token security, executing swaps across DEX aggregators, managing governance participation, and monitoring gas prices across multiple networks.
